title: What AutoDiag checks (diagnostic rules)
keywords: autodiag rules rule checks what does it check findings codes selftest domain rmw qos discovery shared memory severity
text: AutoDiag has 23 rules: the environment (ROS not sourced, invalid or unsafe domain IDs, no network interfaces), two-machine differences (domain, RMW including Zenoh vs DDS — that pairing is an error because they cannot talk — distro, discovery range, localhost-only, multicast), DDS configuration files (missing XML, Cyclone config with another RMW), topic QoS (reliability, durability, latched data with a volatile subscriber, message type) and transports (shared memory across containers, intra-process expectations). Each finding has a code, a severity, evidence, a next step and official documentation. dds-autodiag selftest and the dashboard Tool check run every rule against synthetic faults (Detected means the engine works, not that those systems communicate). The dashboard Live rule check runs the same codes on this host, the loaded peer and this host's live graph: Fault, Pass or Skipped.
